newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Styland sells properties for HK$82 mln.
newsitem.headline: Styland sells properties for HK$82 mln.

text.p: Styland Holdings Ltd said it would sell five properties in Hong Kong and China for a total HK$82.20 million, of which part of the proceeds would be reserved for investment in infrastructure projects in China.

The garment, property development and securities trading concern said it would sell the properties to independent third party Chung Tien (Hong Kong) Co Ltd and that the deal would be completed on May 29.

The properties to be sold included Styland's head office and two commercial and industrial properties in Hong Kong, and a piece of industrial site and a five storey factory building both in Zhongshan City in China's Guangdong province.

Styland said HK$24 million of the proceeds would be used to repay mortgages on the two Hong Kong properties and HK$30 million would be reserved for investment in China infrastructure projects which had not yet been identified.
HK$28.2 million would be earmarked for working capital.
The disposal would enable the company to change its investment profile, the company said.
Styland said it was considering moving its head office to a smaller unit for cost saving purposes while its property in China was vacant and did not generating any income.
